finding: If native helper Popen returns no handle, or a known helper exits without a validated final counter receipt, a final raw.json would incorrectly classify last-checkpoint counters as complete.
correction: Require every attempted native helper to be physically closed and its final complete result/counter receipt validated before writing raw.json. Otherwise preserve raw.partial.json and explicit UNKNOWN backend scope with captured counter values; no retry. Valid captured native helpers followed by a later model API error retain existing logical model attempted/completed accounting.
